message.content:
It’s hard to pick a single “best” player because different people value different qualities—goal‑scoring, playmaking, defensive work rate, leadership, etc. That said, here are a few names that most pundits and fans would agree are among the very best in the world right now:

| Player | Position | Current Club | Why they’re considered top |
|--------|----------|--------------|----------------------------|
| **Lionel Messi** | Forward/Playmaker | Inter Miami (MLS) | Still scoring and creating at a high level, even after moving to MLS. |
| **Cristiano Ronaldo** | Forward | Al Nassr (Saudi Pro League) | Continues to score consistently and brings experience and leadership. |
| **Kylian Mbappé** | Forward | Paris Saint‑Germain | Speed, skill, and goal‑scoring prowess keep him at the top of the list. |
| **Erling Haaland** | Striker | Manchester City | Record‑breaking goal‑scoring rate in the Premier League and Champions League. |
| **Kevin De Bruyne** | Midfielder | Manchester City | One of the best passers and playmakers in the world. |
| **Karim Benzema** | Forward | Real Madrid | Consistent goal‑scoring and link‑up play in La Liga and Europe. |

If you’re looking for a definitive ranking, it often comes down to personal preference and the style of play you enjoy. But if you had to choose one, many would point to **Erling Haaland** for his sheer goal‑scoring efficiency, or **Lionel Messi** for his overall influence on the game.
message.reasoning: The user asks "What is the best player in soccer today?" This is a subjective question. We can provide an answer. There's no tool needed. Just respond with an opinion or mention top players like Lionel Messi, Cristiano Ronaldo, Kylian Mbappé, Erling Haaland, etc. Provide context.
